notes.title: Launched today!
notes.content:
Hi there,
Today, July 3, 2023, "Secret Summoner" was launched!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345394/b6044d2af90226234ca228bb7246feb0034a27ef.jpg[/img]

The price is 7.99USD / 7.79€ / £6.69 . 
For the first week after release, the game will be available at 10% off as a launch sale.
If you are a fan of strategy/puzzle games with a bit of a bone to pick, please give this title a try!

notes.title: Demo version now available
notes.content:
Hi there,
Today we have released a demo version of "Secret Summoner"!
Please try it out from the "Demo Download" on the product page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345394/c1a91f742e8713b8482d79a25f26ab6125f49d6d.jpg[/img]

The demo version includes a tutorial and a "forest," which is the earliest area of the game. The forest is divided into three stages, and if certain conditions are met, you will be able to play a special stage with a higher level of difficulty. We hope you enjoy The demo version and look forward to the release of the full game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345394/cb4e7670cb67cd67122d6566a3af449754f62cf0.jpg[/img]

The demo version allows you to meet the basic rules of the game and understand the flow of the game.
Various worlds await you in the main game, including lakes, caves, and graveyards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345394/c7ae6629ccc52cc805bf8bfb2af1d07eae0b02b0.jpg[/img]

[b]The full game will be released in early July.[/b]
Keep your eyes on us!

notes.title: The store page for "Secret Summoner" is now open!
notes.content:
[b]The Steam product page for the summoning action-puzzle "Secret Summoner" is now available![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345394/426e6962518daeec2dcfb1a8e65a43898d4745f3.jpg[/img]

[b]【STORY】[/b]
The remote country of Attecatol was a peaceful land until only a year prior.
Now, monsters that appear out of nowhere throw their weight around, attacking people as they go.
But this does not sit well with a brain little boy.
So he sets out to discipline the vile creatures.

"Dear Mommy, I am going on a quest to teach those monsters a lesson.
Please look after Shiva for me.
Love,
Little Hero"

As much as I want to respect my Little Hero's desires, 
venturing out on his own is just a bit too risky at his age...

I know! I'll secretly follow him and support him from the shadows!
Now that it's decided, let's set off right away! Come along, Shiva!
An adventure of mother and child⁠—and pooch⁠—begins.


[b]Hello.
This is WakuWaku Games.[/b]

Today, I am very happy to introduce a new game "Secret Summoner," which I recommend to all PC game fans who are using Steam. In this game, you play the role of a summoner mom who secretly supports the adventures of her beloved son "Little Hero" from the shadows, and must successfully guide him through his adventures.

So, should the summoner's mom just go out there and beat up all the monsters that appear? In order for Little Hero to be able to defeat the monsters without effort, he should beat up the monsters that stand in his way to the point of death, just moderately. This is the key to the game. If he beats the monsters, he will not grow up (Level up). On the other hand, if he is beaten up, he will lose confidence and go home.

And it is the monsters who are beaten up by the heroes.
If the monster you beat up on your journey rises up, you have a "chance to obey". If you can make a successful contract, the number of monsters your mom can summon will increase.
If you can make a good contract, you will be able to summon more monsters and help him in his adventures.

Sneak Summoner" is a game that combines the features of various genres: strategic thinking about how to summon monsters efficiently according to the monsters that stand in your path, action to determine the timing of summoning monsters according to the speed of progress, and puzzle elements to make monsters fight each other according to their compatibility and strength. The game is almost complete and is currently in production.

The production of the game is almost complete, and play checks are currently being conducted.
The game is currently undergoing play checks and is scheduled for release in the winter of this year.
We hope you will give this game your attention.

Thanks!
